To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stool Xpert detected 68% of microbiologically confirmed TB cases, including 76.9 and 50% of HIV-infected and HIV-uninfected children, respectively.

1) stool Xpert is an alternative to sputum Xpert in children suspected of pulmonary TB when sputum is not available; 2) stool Xpert detected 50% of non-HIV infected and 77% of HIV infected children with microbiologically-confirmed pulmonary TB; and 3) stool Xpert may be a useful tool for TB screening in children, especially in resource-constrained settings where sputum induction is not routinely available.
stool Xpert is an alternative screening test for childhood pulmonary TB when sputum is not available.
